name: Auto Post Publisher
author: ExertLogics

sections.description:
Auto Post Publisher ensures that your scheduled posts are published even if they miss their scheduled time. It’s especially useful for websites with high traffic or busy schedules where posts might get delayed. The plugin works seamlessly with all post types and provides an easy-to-use settings interface for better control.

Features:

  • Automatically checks for missed scheduled posts
  • Works with custom post types
  • Simple settings interface
  • Select which post types to monitor
  • No configuration needed – works out of the box
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/auto-post-publisher directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Auto Post Publisher to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Which post types are supported?

By default, the plugin works with regular posts and pages. You can enable other public post types in the settings.

How often does it check for missed posts?

The plugin checks for missed scheduled posts whenever someone visits your site’s homepage or any single post/page.

What if I have a lot of missed posts?

Missed posts are processed in batches to prevent server timeouts, ensuring efficient handling even when many posts are pending.

Can I monitor all post types?

Yes, you can select which post types to monitor from the plugin settings.
